summary: Full E2E test of PNG Realty MVP. 23/23 backend pytest tests pass; frontend home/buy/detail/admin flows verified.

minor.issue: Backend prefers cookie over Bearer header (server.py:45-49). Login sets access_token cookie AND returns token, so a shared requests.Session sees the wrong identity when tokens are swapped. Frontend uses Bearer only (localStorage png_token) so is unaffected, but API consumers can be confused. Consider prefer-Bearer-over-cookie or make cookie opt-in.
Returns {requirement, matches} object; test spec said 'returns matches sorted by score'. Matches are correctly sorted by score desc (verified 90,75,55,45,30,15). Frontend may need to read .matches.
Response shape is {key, value:{...}} not flat. PUT accepts a flat body but GET wraps it. Frontend must read from .value. Works but inconsistent.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign in button is not type='submit'; pressing Enter in password field does not submit the form
Browser tab title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'PNG Realty'

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option>. Coming from dev-tool wrapping of option text; consider ensuring options render plain string children.
Seed properties have only 1-2 images so gallery shows repeated placeholder — cosmetic, seed-data limitation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Set <title>PNG Realty | Papua New Guinea Real Estate</title> in public/index.html.
OPTIONAL: Change Sign in button to type='submit' inside a <form onSubmit> so Enter key works.
OPTIONAL: Standardize /api/content/site response as flat object (or document {key,value} shape).
OPTIONAL: In get_current_user, prefer Authorization header over cookie for stateless API consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 667 lines — consider splitting into routers/models modules if it grows further.
Requirement/property matching endpoint returns wrapper object; other list endpoints return arrays. Inconsistent envelope.
public/leads creates a new Customer each time even for repeat email — no de-duplication (may inflate customer count).
CORS uses allow_origins=* with credentials=false; login also sets a cookie though — cookie flow only works same-origin. Documented behavior only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (home, buy list+filter, detail, admin login, 11 admin routes, logout)

test_credentials: admin@pngrealty.pg / Admin@123 (system_admin), sales@pngrealty.pg / Password@123 (sales_agent) — both verified working.
seed_data_creation: Public forms created TEST_Seller, TEST_Wanted, TEST_Inspector leads/customers and 1 TEST requirement via public API during pytest runs (not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables xdist which conflicts if plugin missing). All endpoints healthy. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Bearer-token auth (localStorage png_token). Admin login page: use get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'); button is NOT type=submit.
